name: Citrus-Soy Glazed Strip Steak with Pineapple & Bell Pepper Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup jasmine rice
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ orange
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
½ small pineapple
1 red bell pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, juice orange into a small bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the orange juice along with soy sauce, honey, oil, salt, and crushed red pepper. Stir to combine the glaze and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
1 tsp honey
extra virgin olive oil
salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat steak dry with paper towels and thinly slice against the grain. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add steak and half of the glaze; cook, stirring occasionally, until steak is just cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet and remaining glaze for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the green onions.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels, return to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions, pineapple, and bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until pineapple softens, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat and cover to keep warm.
When the rice is done, add to the skillet, along with reserved glaze, and stir to combine.
To serve, divide pineapple rice and steak between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
